general: Extract every entity of the supplied types. Return exact spans from the query. Leave other text unlabelled.

classes.name: Time
classes.description: Specific and well-defined time intervals, such as eras, historical periods, centuries, years and important days.
rules: TI1 No months and days of the week.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: Sport events, battles, wars and other events.
rules: EV1 Examples: "World War II", "World War I", "American Civil War", "FA Cup", "Vietnam War".

classes.name: Disease
classes.description: Physical, mental, infectious, non-infectious, deficiency, inherited, degenerative, social and self-inflicted diseases.

classes.name: Vehicle
rules: VE1 Examples: "Airbus A380", "Titanic", "Tupolev Tu-144", "Mayflower", "Dornier Do X".

classes.name: Celestial
classes.description: Planets, stars, asteroids, comets, nebulae, galaxies and other astronomical objects.

classes.name: Organization
classes.description: Associations, companies, agencies, institutions, nationalities and religious or political groups.
rules: OR1 Examples: "European Union", "BBC", "Boston Red Sox", "New York Yankees", "Pittsburgh Pirates".

classes.name: Instrument
classes.description: Technological instruments, mechanical instruments, musical instruments, and other tools.

classes.name: Animal
classes.description: Breeds of dogs, cats and other animals, including their scientific names.

classes.name: Biological
classes.description: Genus of fungus, bacteria and protoctists, families of viruses, and other biological entities.

classes.name: Plant
classes.description: Types of trees, flowers, and other plants, including their scientific names.

classes.name: Location
classes.description: Physical locations (e.g. mountains, bodies of water), geopolitical entities (e.g. cities, states), and facilities (e.g. bridges, buildings, airports)

classes.name: Media
classes.description: Titles of films, books, magazines, songs and albums, fictional characters and languages.
rules: ME1 Examples: "Rotten Tomatoes", "Oxford English Dictionary", "TV Guide", "Entertainment Weekly", "Rolling Stone".
